source_tables.title: EXHIBIT A – TABLE OF PLAN COVERAGE

notes: The document does not publish a distribution of retired members by 5-year age band. It only provides aggregate counts and average ages for 'Retired members' (7,355 members, avg age 72.9) and 'Beneficiaries' (1,960 members, avg age 80.7) in Exhibit A (Page 42). No table breaks down the 'Number' or 'Average Benefit' by specific age ranges (e.g., 50-54, 55-59). Consequently, the target grid cannot be populated. The source table is transcribed as archived evidence of the available aggregate data. The target requires 'SERVICE retirees only', but the document does not separate service retirees from disabled retirees or beneficiaries in a way that allows for age-banded extraction.
